summary: A paired phone can register its push token with st; nothing sends pushes yet

replay.detail: No claim or projection replay. Registrations are not claims and are never replicated.

schema.detail: Adds a local push registration table keyed by person and paired device. Existing stores create it empty on first open; no claim kind, shared projection or replication change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: Adds the optional push-registration capability, the push.register and push.unregister client commands on /v1/client/push-registration, and an optional push summary on device resources. Older clients ignore them; newer clients must check the capability, since older servers do not have the route.

manual.detail: No manual upgrade step. Sending pushes needs a later release and an APNs key.

recovery.detail: Registrations are local and disposable; a lost table only means phones register again on their next launch.
